en.headline: Light goods vehicle overturns on Central Kowloon Route near Kai Tak
en.dek: The driver was uninjured after the vehicle left the road around 6 a.m.; affected Yau Ma Tei-bound lanes at the Kai Tak interchange were temporarily closed and later reopened.
body: A light goods vehicle overturned on the Central Kowloon Route near the Kai Tak interchange early on Monday, briefly closing several lanes in the Yau Ma Tei direction.

The Transport Department said the incident occurred around 6 a.m. as the vehicle travelled along Kai Fuk Road towards the Central Kowloon Route. Rescue personnel freed the driver; no injuries were reported.

At 6.32 a.m. the department advised that the full stretch of the Kai Tak interchange slip road near the Hong Kong Post building leading onto the Central Kowloon Route (Yau Ma Tei section) had been closed. Motorists were asked to use alternative routes. By mid-morning the affected lanes had reopened and traffic was moving again.

zh.headline: 中九龍繞道輕型貨車翻側 啟德交匯處一度全線封閉
zh.dek: 今早約6時一輛輕型貨車在啟福道近啟德交匯處失控翻側，司機無恙；往油麻地方向支路一度全封，其後重開。
body: 今日（17日）清晨約6時，一輛輕型貨車沿啟福道往中九龍繞道方向行駛，至香港郵政大樓對開位置懷疑失控向左翻側，橫臥數條行車線。
救援人員到場將司機救出，事件中無人受傷。運輸署於6時32分表示，受意外影響，由啟福道通往中九龍繞道（油麻地段）往油麻地方向的啟德交匯處支路近香港郵政大樓一段全線封閉，呼籲駕駛人士改用其他道路。
其後有關路段已重開，交通回復正常。
